spec.splits: same grouping/bucketing recipe and seed 42 as v1, five folds, validation=(test+1) mod 5

selection.policy: validation-only, per fold and domain; ties keep the cheaper / lower-alpha option
selection.h_star: v1 rule over CC alpha 0.1..0.9 and RRF k=60 on FAISS top-100 lists
selection.p_star: best of [bm25, BM25+static-proxy CC alpha 0.1..0.9] on BM25 top-100
selection.r_star: best of [BM25+query-vector re-scoring CC alpha 0.1..0.9] on BM25 top-100 (no FAISS)
selection.thresholds: v1 C6 rule, pooled over the four domains' validation rows, 0.005 macro and 0.01 per-domain loss vs S* (S*_all for the cascade), lowest dense ratio wins

analysis.metric: nDCG@10, equal-weight macro over the four domains
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over H1-H5 at family-wise alpha 0.05 (one-sided bootstrap p-values)

hypotheses.H3: PE-GH v1 (v1 mode, v1_ridge) is non-inferior to S* (margin 0.01)
hypotheses.H4: PE-GH v1 beats the 30-seed random router at its own per-fold dense counts
hypotheses.H5: cascade v1_ridge beats the 30-seed random router at its own per-fold dense counts

secondary_reported_without_claims: PE-GH v1 minus BM25-margin and minus LiteGator-style SVM at matched budget (two-sided CI); development data predict no significant difference
R* superiority over H*; per-domain results; quality-vs-budget curves; AUC/Spearman
feature-group ablations (qpp, proxy) in both modes
spec.negative_results_policy: every hypothesis is reported whatever the outcome; no threshold, alpha grid, feature or model change after the fresh labels are scored
